images.name: gray
images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: website article thumbnail, square image. Create a realistic architectural photograph of a beautiful clean two-car Florida garage with a professionally finished full-broadcast decorative vinyl flake floor. Color palette of floor: silver gray, charcoal and white. Floor occupies lower two thirds of frame, visibly dense small irregular decorative chips, glossy clear finish with controlled reflections, consistent real-world chip scale, neutral white garage walls and tidy cabinets at back, daylight. View from low doorway angle emphasizing floor finish. No people, cars, words, logos or watermarks. This is a design concept, not a documented completed project.
